selectors_tableHeaderParentSelectors.description:
A scraper could be configured like
  this <product links selector> -> [<title selector>, <price selector>]. In this
  case, the product links selector is a parent selector and title and price
  selectors are child selectors. The parent selector is used to extract the
  links to item pages and then the child selectors are used to extract data from
  those item pages.
